name: Easystory360 Ultimate
author: explorations360

sections.description:
Easily embed Easystory360 VR stories on your WordPress site. No shortcode needed.

Description (fr_FR)

Intégrez facilement vos stories Easystory360 en VR sur votre site WordPress.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Easystory360 viewer service to display VR stories embedded in your WordPress content.

What the service is and what it is used for:
– Easystory360 is a VR story viewing platform that hosts and serves interactive 360-degree content
– The service is used to display VR stories through embedded iframes on your WordPress site

What data is sent and when:
– When a visitor views an embedded VR story, their browser makes a direct connection to viewer.easystory360.tools
– Standard web request data is sent including: IP address, browser information, referrer URL, and viewing timestamp
– No personal data from your WordPress site is actively transmitted by this plugin
– The embedded iframe may set cookies and collect analytics data according to Easystory360’s privacy policy

Service provider links:
– Service provider: Easystory360 (explorations360.com)
– Terms of service: https://www.explorations360.com/terms-of-service
– Privacy policy: https://www.explorations360.com/privacy-policy

Users should review these terms and privacy policies to understand how their data is handled when viewing embedded VR content.

Installation (fr_FR)

  1. Téléchargez et installez le plugin.
  2. Activez-le via le menu Extensions de WordPress.
  3. Utilisez le bloc, le widget, le générateur de code dans l’admin, ou le bouton TinyMCE selon vos besoins.

Changelog (fr_FR)

= 1.15 =
* Code mis à jour selon les standards WordPress
* Ajout des fonctions wp_enqueue appropriées pour les styles et scripts
* Documentation des services externes ajoutée
* Sécurité améliorée avec des préfixes de fonction uniques
* Meilleur support de traduction

1.0

  • Première version publique : widget, générateur de code, bouton TinyMCE, prêt pour la traduction.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the block, widget, admin generator, or TinyMCE button as needed.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin compatible with page builders like DIVI, Elementor, WPBakery?

Yes! You can use the generated HTML code in any builder (use the generator in the admin).

Can I use it with the classic editor?

Yes! There is a TinyMCE button that lets you insert your VR story visually, no shortcode required.

Does this plugin send data to external servers?

The plugin itself does not send data to external servers. However, when visitors view embedded VR stories, their browsers connect directly to viewer.easystory360.tools to load the content. Please see the “External Services” section for full details.

Puis-je l’utiliser avec DIVI, Elementor, WPBakery ?

Oui ! Générez le code HTML via l’outil dans l’admin et copiez-le dans n’importe quel constructeur de page.

Y a-t-il un bouton pour l’éditeur classique ?

Oui, le bouton “Easystory360” apparaît dans la barre d’outils de l’éditeur classique.
